messages.content:
You are a quantitative researcher. Your job: discover trading rules for crypto perpetual futures that make money AFTER costs.

MARKET AND EXECUTION
- 20 liquid USDT perpetuals on Bybit (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, LTC, AAVE, ARB, COTI, DOT, NEAR, SHIB, SUI, UNI, XLM, ZEC).
- A rule is checked at the close of every hour on every coin. When all its conditions are true, the bot enters at the next hour's open with a market order.
- Exit: stop-loss at stop_atr x atr_d from entry, otherwise at the close after hold_hours. One open position per rule per coin.
- Round-trip cost is about 0.17% of price (fees + slippage). A trade with a 5% stop pays ~0.03R in costs.
- Target frequency: all your rules together should trade about 2-5 times per week across the 20 coins, i.e. each rule roughly 0.02-0.3 signals per coin per week. Very rare rules are useless; very frequent rules drown in costs.

DATA (hourly, 2022-01..2024-06 shown to you; later years are held out to test you)
- ret_1h: price change over the last 1h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -1.37 / -0.38 / 0 / 0.386 / 1.35
- ret_4h: price change over 4h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -2.81 / -0.759 / 0 / 0.765 / 2.77
- ret_24h: price change over 24h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -6.84 / -2.18 / -0.066 / 2 / 7.19
- ret_72h: price change over 72h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -11.6 / -3.95 / -0.231 / 3.66 / 12.5
- ret_7d: price change over 7 days, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -18.1 / -6.38 / -0.543 / 5.82 / 19.9
- range_pos_7d: position of price in its 7-day high-low range: 0 = at the low, 1 = at the high. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.0925 / 0.26 / 0.476 / 0.724 / 0.916
- atr_d: average daily high-low range over 14 days, % of price. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 3.14 / 4.77 / 6.3 / 8.36 / 12.4
- vol_z: quote volume of the last 24h divided by the 30-day median daily volume (1 = normal). Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.439 / 0.695 / 0.945 / 1.34 / 2.87
- taker_1h: share of volume bought aggressively (market buys) in the last hour; 0.5 = balanced. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.421 / 0.465 / 0.492 / 0.518 / 0.561
- taker_4h: aggressive-buy share over 4h. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.45 / 0.476 / 0.491 / 0.506 / 0.529
- taker_24h: aggressive-buy share over 24h. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.469 / 0.482 / 0.491 / 0.499 / 0.511
- taker_24h_dev: taker_24h minus its own 30-day average (positive = unusual buying pressure). Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -0.0197 / -0.00753 / 0.000228 / 0.00774 / 0.0189
- size_z: average trade size over 24h divided by its 30-day median (>1 = bigger players active). Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.784 / 0.908 / 0.992 / 1.08 / 1.27
- buy_ratio: share of Bybit accounts that are long (retail crowd positioning), 0..1. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.503 / 0.609 / 0.689 / 0.756 / 0.834
- buy_ratio_chg_24h: change of buy_ratio over 24h, percentage points. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -6.6 / -1.57 / 0.08 / 1.72 / 6.33
- buy_ratio_pct_30d: percentile of buy_ratio within the last 30 days, 0..1. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.0292 / 0.229 / 0.528 / 0.815 / 0.983
- oi_chg_4h: open interest change over 4h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -4.74 / -1.18 / 0.0293 / 1.25 / 4.89
- oi_chg_24h: open interest change over 24h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -10.6 / -3.03 / 0.0975 / 3.25 / 12.4
- oi_chg_72h: open interest change over 72h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -16.7 / -4.86 / 0.456 / 6.01 / 21.8
- funding_bp: last funding rate, basis points per 8h (positive = longs pay shorts). Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -1.94 / 0.577 / 1 / 1 / 3.24
- funding_pct_30d: percentile of funding within the last 30 days, 0..1. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0.0472 / 0.306 / 0.523 / 0.692 / 0.928
- btc_ret_4h: BTC change over 4h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -1.66 / -0.386 / 0.00716 / 0.406 / 1.71
- btc_ret_24h: BTC change over 24h, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -4.31 / -1.17 / 0.0205 / 1.26 / 4.72
- btc_ret_7d: BTC change over 7 days, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -11.1 / -3.39 / 0.167 / 4.18 / 14.2
- rel_24h: this coin 24h change minus BTC 24h change, %. Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): -4.69 / -1.6 / -0.143 / 1.08 / 5.19
- hour_utc: UTC hour of the decision (0..23). Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 1 / 6 / 12 / 18 / 22
- weekday: weekday of the decision (0 = Monday). Typical values (5/25/50/75/95%): 0 / 1 / 3 / 5 / 6

RULE FORMAT (JSON only)
{"rules": [
  {"name": "short snake_case name", "side": "long" or "short",
    "conditions": [["feature", "<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=", number], ...],
    "hold_hours": integer 6..96, "stop_atr": number 0.3..2.0,
    "why": "one sentence: the market mechanism you exploit"}
]}
Use only the feature names above. 2-4 conditions per rule. Think about WHO is forced to trade and WHY price should move: crowd positioning, liquidations, aggressive flow, funding costs, reversal vs continuation.

RESULTS OF YOUR PREVIOUS RULES ON 2022-01..2024-06 (after costs; t>=2 and >=1 trade/week across all coins is what counts; negative average means the idea loses):
- round 1 funding_crowd_squeeze (short, [["funding_bp", ">=", 3.0], ["buy_ratio_pct_30d", ">=", 0.95]], hold 24, stop 1.5): 501 trades, 3.85/week, avg -0.003R per trade, t=-0.1, win 54%
- round 1 whale_trend_follow (long, [["ret_24h", ">=", 2.0], ["size_z", ">=", 1.27], ["oi_chg_24h", ">=", 3.0]], hold 48, stop 1.0): 399 trades, 3.06/week, avg +0.087R per trade, t=+1.4, win 46%
- round 1 capitulation_reversal (long, [["range_pos_7d", "<=", 0.1], ["oi_chg_24h", "<=", -3.0], ["ret_24h", "<=", -2.0]], hold 48, stop 1.5): 967 trades, 7.42/week, avg -0.087R per trade, t=-4.2, win 48%
- round 1 absorption_long (long, [["taker_24h_dev", ">=", 0.018], ["ret_24h", "<=", -1.0], ["vol_z", ">=", 1.5]], hold 24, stop 1.2): 71 trades, 0.54/week, avg +0.032R per trade, t=+0.3, win 51%
- round 1 alpha_weakness_short (short, [["btc_ret_24h", ">=", 2.0], ["rel_24h", "<=", -2.0], ["oi_chg_24h", "<=", -3.0]], hold 24, stop 1.5): 1014 trades, 7.78/week, avg -0.005R per trade, t=-0.4, win 52%
- round 1 neg_funding_short_squeeze (long, [["funding_bp", "<=", -2.0], ["buy_ratio_pct_30d", "<=", 0.03]], hold 48, stop 1.5): 255 trades, 1.96/week, avg +0.044R per trade, t=+0.9, win 46%
- round 1 intraday_surge_cont (long, [["ret_1h", ">=", 1.0], ["taker_1h", ">=", 0.55], ["vol_z", ">=", 2.0]], hold 12, stop 1.0): 585 trades, 4.49/week, avg +0.045R per trade, t=+1.8, win 47%
- round 1 retail_panic_reversal (long, [["buy_ratio_chg_24h", "<=", -7.0], ["range_pos_7d", "<=", 0.25], ["oi_chg_4h", "<=", -1.5]], hold 48, stop 1.5): 195 trades, 1.50/week, avg +0.042R per trade, t=+0.8, win 56%
- round 1 weekly_crap_shakeout (long, [["ret_7d", "<=", -11.0], ["range_pos_7d", "<=", 0.15], ["oi_chg_72h", ">=", 4.0]], hold 72, stop 2.0): 503 trades, 3.86/week, avg -0.078R per trade, t=-2.7, win 49%
- round 1 flow_range_divergence_short (short, [["taker_24h_dev", "<=", -0.018], ["range_pos_7d", ">=", 0.85], ["buy_ratio_pct_30d", ">=", 0.85]], hold 24, stop 1.5): 38 trades, 0.29/week, avg -0.002R per trade, t=-0.0, win 61%
Keep what works, fix what almost works, drop what loses, and try new mechanisms.

Propose 10 rules. Answer with the JSON object only.
